descriptions.slides: A short slide deck that Pip reads aloud, with captions.
descriptions.sequence: Learners reorder shuffled steps (e.g. the phases of a sprint).
descriptions.sort: Learners drop cards into the right group (e.g. "give to AI" vs "do it yourself").
descriptions.quiz: Multiple-choice questions with an explanation after each answer.
descriptions.roleplay: Chat with an AI character (client, interviewer, teammate) and get scored on a rubric.
descriptions.coding: Write or fix a small JavaScript function; tests run in the browser.
descriptions.codingExercise: Write or fix a small JavaScript function; tests run in the browser.
descriptions.reading: Read the lesson, then mark it as done.

frame.unknownType: Unknown activity type “{type}”. Is its module registered?
frame.invalidSetup: This {type} has an invalid setup. An instructor needs to fix it in the studio.
